title: Vietnamese Style Pork Shoulder Pho
description: A delicious and flavorful Vietnamese-inspired pho made with tender pork shoulder and a rich broth. Serve with rice noodles and fresh herbs for a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the quick broth, tangy fish sauce, onion, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pork shoulder to the pot and simmer for 2-3 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pork from the pot and slice it thinly against the grain.
Add the sliced pork back to the pot and simmer for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and divide them among bowls.
Add the hot pork and broth to the bowls and garnish with vietnamese cilantro.
